info.name: Obsura API
info.description:
Professional Postman collection for Obsura API.

Quick start:
1. Set `baseUrl` to your target deployment.
2. Run create endpoints for patterns, entities, or configurations.
3. The collection automatically captures IDs such as `patternId`, `configurationId`, `bulkId`, `jobId`, and `findingId` from JSON responses.
4. Follow the text, CSV, document, structured, or image workflow requests in order without manually copying IDs.
5. Bulk text requests follow the review-first order: analyze -> get child job -> review -> transform.
6. CSV exports in this collection are formula-safe and should be used as the download source.
7. PDF document examples use multipart upload plus `manifest_json` and require resubmitting the file for reviewed transforms.
8. Bulk text responses keep parent bulk state and per-item outcomes separate.
9. Structured workflow examples include nested JSON payloads for field-level review.
10. Image workflow examples include OCR-ready `manifest_json` payloads for screenshot testing.
11. When no analyze configuration is passed, the API falls back to PII+IP+Email+Phone with confidence >= 80%.

  "title": "Screenshot safe-share export",
